title: Adelaide Gaol
geometryBasis: The identified Adelaide Gaol boundary, mapped historic perimeter controls, central radial yard walls, 13 building plans and the exact two octagonal footprints. The 2022 state LiDAR building occupancy independently locates the south-facing roof edge.
sectionBasis: The City of Adelaide heritage record supplies the 18-foot exterior wall, 10-foot interior walls, octagonal towers and two-storey T-shaped 1879 addition. Surviving site relief is from the original Terrarium field.
limitations: Most individual roof profiles, finished grade contacts and opening schedules are exterior estimates. The public-domain photograph fixes the central sandstone arch and white studded doors.
The original terrain preserves the mapped context and samples the approach at composite raster resolution.

The administration frontage is assigned to the south edge of the mapped 232525390 roof. The precise doorway position, the height along the southeast curtain, and the modern watch tower section are inferred.

administration.basis: The Georgian frontage is placed on the south-facing side of the classifier-confirmed OSM 232525390 roof. The centered door and front section are reconstructed, with location within the footprint inferred.
